description: This file 'sugar_file_utils.php' contains utility functions for file operations such as directory creation, file opening, reading, writing, and permission management. It serves as a helper library to standardize file handling with permission settings within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM project.

methods.name: sugar_mkdir
methods.description: Creates a directory with pre-configured permissions, supports recursive creation, and sets permissions, owner, and group based on global settings.

methods.name: sugar_fopen
methods.description: Opens a file, creating it if it does not exist, applying pre-configured permissions.

methods.name: sugar_fclose
methods.description: Closes a file handle and cleans the cache if the file is a PHP file.

methods.name: sugar_file_put_contents
methods.description: Writes data to a file, creating it if necessary, with permission handling and cache invalidation for PHP files.

methods.name: sugar_file_put_contents_atomic
methods.description: Performs an atomic write to a file by writing to a temporary file and renaming it, then sets permissions.

methods.name: sugar_file_get_contents
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file, creating it if missing, with read permission checks.

methods.name: sugar_touch
methods.description: Sets access and modification time of a file, creating it if needed, and applies default permissions.

methods.name: sugar_chmod
methods.description: Changes file permissions based on configuration or provided mode.

methods.name: sugar_chown
methods.description: Changes file owner based on configuration settings.

methods.name: sugar_chgrp
methods.description: Changes file group based on configuration settings.

methods.name: get_mode
methods.description: Retrieves mode setting from configuration or defaults to provided value.

methods.name: sugar_cached
methods.description: Returns the path to a cached file in the cache directory.

methods.name: sugar_is_dir
methods.description: Deprecated wrapper around PHP’s is_dir function.

methods.name: sugar_is_file
methods.description: Deprecated wrapper around PHP’s is_file function.
